__doc__: Discovery config: one or more sources, merged by id (later sources override). Failures are non-fatal — a flaky source returns nothing and the previous active list is kept.

sources.__note__: Keeps your hand-curated sites in the active set even if no other source finds them.
Pulls merchant URLs from a sitemap. Cheapest source — works for any platform that publishes one.
Drop in the real internal tenant endpoint. The agent expects an array of { id, url, active, themeVersion, ... }. See src/discovery.js for the full contract.

__behavior__.__doc__: intervalMs is read by serve.js — how often to re-discover. archiveRemoved moves a deactivated merchant's learned profiles to profiles/_archive/ instead of deleting them.
